svg.aria-label: UDON Logo (Universal Document Object Notation) - Sumi-e and Hiragana
svg.title: UDON Logo (Universal Document Object Notation) - Sumi-e and Hiragana
svg.desc: Minimalist sumi-e ink brush logo for UDON (Universal Document Object Notation), featuring four stepped pipe strokes forming a U-shaped Don bowl, a vermilion hanko seal with the kanji Don (丼), and clean geometric typography.
